subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the linked fork PR for this doctor check, or close that branch and leave this issue for a fresh narrow implementation?
rationale: The source-level bug shape is clear, but the existing implementation candidate is open, unmerged, and conflicting, so automation should not create a competing fix before maintainers choose the branch path.

options.title: Adopt or rebase the linked branch
options.body: Use the existing branch as the starting point if its doctor helper can be updated cleanly against current main and validated with focused doctor and gateway-lock tests.

options.title: Close the branch and allow a fresh fix
options.body: If the fork PR is too stale or hard to salvage, close it and then let a new narrow implementation target this issue.

options.title: Park both items
options.body: Keep this issue open without implementation work if maintainers want to defer additional doctor recovery coverage for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt or rebase the linked branch
recommendation.body: Use the existing branch as the starting point if its doctor helper can be updated cleanly against current main and validated with focused doctor and gateway-lock tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and hardened the central gateway lock behavior and has recent merge history on related gateway-lock cleanup decisions.
